snippet.title: The Legend of Heroes: Trails from Zero - Announcement Trailer (Nintendo Switch 2, PS5)
snippet.description:
Welcome back to Crossbell! The Legend of Heroes: Trails from Zero is coming to the Nintendo Switch 2 and PlayStation 5 with improved performance, higher resolution, and upscaled textures to create the most visually striking version of this legendary title to date!

When Lloyd Bannings is assigned to Crossbell's Special Support Section, he and his new teammates must prove themselves as they fight to overcome the injustice of a city gripped by corruption.

Experience the definitive version of The Legend of Heroes: Trails from Zero later this year!

Follow @NISAmerica on X, Instagram, and Facebook for updates! 
Learn more @ https://www.thelegendofheroes.com/crossbell/zero/

#TrailsfromZero
